title: HTTP/3 WebSocket TCP Forwarder Buffering Work Item
summary: Add an explicit TCP forwarder options surface and local proof that TCP response bytes are emitted as bounded binary WebSocket chunks.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3WebSocketTcpForwarderOptions.BufferSize` and an options-based forwarding overload.
- Keep the existing integer buffer-size overload and validation behavior.
- Add a loopback WebSocket/TCP test that sends multiple client binary messages, verifies the TCP server receives the combined payload, and verifies a larger TCP response is returned in WebSocket binary frames no larger than the configured buffer.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server TCP forwarder chunking test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: TCP target authorization, DNS resolution, or production proxy routing policy.
QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The TCP forwarder now has an explicit buffering options surface and local proof that TCP responses are returned as bounded binary WebSocket chunks while preserving close handling.
